description: This file contains the implementation of state-reset functions for an HTTP MBO Chunked object, specifically the HttpMboChkReset function which resets internal state variables related to HTTP chunked encoding processing.

classes.name: HTTP_MBO_CHUNKED_OBJECT
classes.description: A structure representing the internal state of an HTTP MBO Chunked object, including various flags and size counters.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkReset(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the HTTP MBO Chunked object to default values, preparing it for a new HTTP chunked transfer sequence.
